description: Values for the Liferay DXP operator chart.

enabled.description: Runs the ClientExtension controller and creates its RBAC.

customEnv.description: Named lists of extra environment variables for the operator container, such as HTTPS_PROXY and NO_PROXY. Set a key to null to remove it.

customLabels.description: Extra labels added to every resource the chart creates.

customVolumeMounts.description: Named lists of extra volume mounts for the operator container. Set a key to null to remove it.

customVolumes.description: Named lists of extra pod volumes, such as a private CA bundle. Set a key to null to remove it.

downloadPollInterval.description: How often add-on downloads are polled, as a Go duration.

enabled.description: Set by a parent chart that includes this chart as a conditional subchart.

expirationGracePeriod.description: How long an expired license keeps a ceiling of one replica before dropping to zero, as a Go duration.

fullnameOverride.description: Overrides the full name of the chart's resources.

global.description: Global values shared by a parent chart.

heartbeatInterval.description: How often the license manifest is refreshed, as a Go duration.

pullSecrets.description: Image pull secrets for the operator pod.

marketplace.description: Shared marketplace volume the operator downloads add-ons into.

claimName.description: Name of the persistent volume claim to mount. Required when the marketplace is enabled.

csi.description: CSI settings for a statically provisioned marketplace volume. The chart creates the volume and claim only when the driver and volume handle are both set.

enabled.description: Mounts the marketplace volume into the operator.

mountPath.description: Path the marketplace volume is mounted at.

size.description: Capacity of the statically provisioned volume and claim.

nameOverride.description: Overrides the chart name used in resource names.

namespaceOverride.description: Installs the namespaced resources into this namespace instead of the release namespace.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector for the operator pod.

onlineActivationWorkflow.description: Argo Workflows ClusterWorkflowTemplate for online activation. Requires Argo Workflows.

defaultEnvironmentName.description: LiferayEnvironment name the workflow targets by default.

enabled.description: Creates the online activation workflow template and its RBAC.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the workflow steps.

serviceAccountName.description: Service account the workflow runs as.

ttlSecondsAfterCompletion.description: Seconds a finished workflow is kept.

waitTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds the workflow waits for activation to complete.

podAnnotations.description: Annotations added to the operator pod.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod security context for the operator.

baseURL.description: Base URL of the provisioning service the operator activates against.

provisioningGracePeriod.description: How long the last known license is honored while the provisioning service is unreachable, as a Go duration.

create.description: Creates the operator ClusterRole and ClusterRoleBinding.

replicaCount.description: Operator replicas. The operator runs no leader election, so at most one.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the operator container.

initialDelay.description: First retry delay, as a Go duration.

maxDelay.description: Longest retry delay, as a Go duration.

securityContext.description: Container security context for the operator.

annotations.description: Annotations added to the service account.

name.description: Service account name. Defaults to the full name when created, or default otherwise.
